properties.name: jwt.secret
properties.description: Secret key used for signing JWT tokens. This is like a special password that the server uses to create and verify user ID cards (JWT tokens). It should be long, random, and kept secret.

properties.name: jwt.expiration
properties.description: JWT token expiration time in milliseconds. This controls how long a user's login session remains valid before they need to log in again. For example, 86400000 equals 24 hours.
